Elk, Grand Mesa, Uncompahgre and Gunnison NF, USFS. Transfer of command from CIMT (RM Team 1) to 
CIMT (RM Team 2) will occur tomorrow. CIMT is also managing the Gold Mountain incident. Seven miles 
northwest of Lake City, CO. Timber, brush and grass. Active fire behavior with uphill runs, flanking and group 
torching. Numerous structures threatened. Evacuations, area, road and trail closures in effect. 
 
Gold Mountain, Grand Mesa, Uncompahgre and Gunnison NF, USFS. Two miles north of Ouray, CO. Grass, 
brush and timber. Active fire behavior with uphill runs, flanking and group torching. Energy infrastructure 
threatened. Area, road and trail closures in effect. 
 
310, Garfield County. One mile east of Battlement Mesa, CO. Brush and timber. Extreme fire behavior with 
wind-driven runs, torching and uphill runs. Numerous residences and critical infrastructure threatened. 
Evacuations, area and road closures in effect. 
 
Rio Blanco, San Juan NF, USFS. Ten miles south of Pagosa Springs, CO. Timber, brush and grass. 
Moderate fire behavior with flanking and smoldering. Numerous structures threatened. 
 
Aspen Acres, Custer County. Twenty miles southwest of Pueblo, CO. Timber. Minimal fire behavior with 
backing and creeping. Area closures in effect. 
 
Willow, Pike and San Isabel NF, USFS. Six miles west of Leadville, CO. Brush, closed timber litter and timber. 
Minimal fire behavior with smoldering. Area, road and trail closures in effect.
